scope.title: Evidence pack: impact of a weaker US dollar on global asset allocation and income opportunities
scope.description: Collect and synthesise evidence on how depreciation of the US dollar affects returns, hedged vs unhedged bond outcomes, equity market performance across regions (developed and emerging), and markets/assets that provide income resilience or inflation hedging.
objectives: Assess the effect of USD weakness on regional equity returns (US, Europe, UK, Asia-Pacific, Emerging Markets).
Compare currency‑hedged vs unhedged bond returns for major investor domiciles.
Identify asset classes and specific markets that offer resilient income or inflation protection during USD declines.
Summarise implications for portfolio allocation and hedging strategies.
research_questions: How have major currencies and regional equity indices performed during periods of USD depreciation (most recent 24–36 months)?
What is the historical performance difference between currency‑hedged and unhedged global bond allocations for US and non‑US investors?
Which countries or sectors have consistently provided income resilience when the USD weakens?
What policy, macro, or market factors modify these relationships (e.g., interest rate differentials, capital flows)?
geography: Emerging Markets (with emphasis on Brazil, South Africa, China, India, Mexico, South Korea)
data_types: Index and market return time series
inclusion_criteria: Provides quantitative evidence or authoritative qualitative analysis relevant to USD movements and asset returns
Sources from recognised providers (institutional research, major index providers, academic journals, central banks)
exclusion_criteria: Anecdotal commentary without data or clear methodology
Promotional materials / marketing collateral lacking independent analysis
Sources older than 2024 unless seminal and explicitly relevant
deliverables: Concise executive summary (2–4 pages) of key findings
Data extraction table (source, metrics, period, main result)
Methodology appendix describing selection and synthesis approach
scope.notes: No EvidencePack schema file was found among the uploaded documents, so the scope above is a best‑practice template. Example uploaded file located in your uploads: MORNINGSTAR - 2026_Global_Outlook_Report .
